name: the-pit-workspace
description: The Pit — a NEAR memecoin launchpad: bonding-curve coins with staked reserves that fund their own AI.

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:js: npm run test:brain && npm run test:gate && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:web
scripts.test:contracts: cargo test --offline --features unit-tests --manifest-path pit/contracts/pit/Cargo.toml && cargo test --offline --features unit-tests --manifest-path pit/contracts/factory/Cargo.toml
